mapper.select: select (select ft.T_Name from SYS_FileTemplate ft where ft.T_Code=mn.Task_Start_T_Code limit 1) as taskStartTName, (select ft.T_Name from SYS_FileTemplate ft where ft.T_Code=mn.Task_End_T_Code limit 1) as taskEndTName, mn.* from Gantt_Tasks_Change mn where Plan_Id=#{planId} order by Task_Sort asc
select count(*) from Gantt_Plan_Change mn left join Gantt_Tasks_Change gtc on gtc.Plan_Id = mn.Plan_Id where gtc.Task_Source = #{id} and gtc.Task_Change_Type = '删除' and mn.Plan_State != 3
